page_title: BharatSHRI – Bharat Shared Repository of Inscriptions
description: Official ASI digital repository of Indian inscriptions. Houses 24,816 metadata records, 24,225 transcripts, and 20,861 estampages covering Tamil, Sanskrit, Dravidian, and Arabic epigraphy. Static HTML content pages are fully accessible without JavaScript.
license_info: Government of India / Archaeological Survey of India (public cultural repository)
notes: Content and editorial pages are static HTML. The portal search (FrontEndSearch.aspx) uses ASP.NET postback with ViewState cookies. Epigraphy branch at Mysore oversees Dravidian and Tamil inscriptions documentation including 45 volumes of South Indian Inscriptions.

description: Official state department website for Tamil Nadu archaeology, housing 1,200+ inscription books, Tamil-Brahmi rock-cut epigraphs catalogue, and Keeladi excavation reports.
notes: UNREACHABLE FROM ENVIRONMENT: Requests to tnarch.gov.in fail with TLS handshake connection timeout. Server may be restricted by geographic IP geo-blocking, strict firewall rules, or downtime. Verified via requests, python socket, and browser subagent.

organization: Keeladi Museum, Government of Tamil Nadu
